parsed_json.up: Select compounds associated with the specified document. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id. Filter by document ChEMBL ID CHEMBL1129278. Retrieve molecule ChEMBL ID as molecule_chembl_id, preferred name as molecule_name, max_phase, molecule_type, and canonical_smiles from compound_structures using a LEFT JOIN to allow missing structures. Order the results by molecule_chembl_id.
